projects.name: 医疗合规 RAG 系统
projects.stack: Python · LangChain · LangGraph · FastAPI · LangServe · 向量数据库
projects.time: 进行中（准备部署至 Render）
points: 面向医疗场景的检索增强生成系统，在传统 RAG 上叠加多层增强机制，确保回答可信、可溯、可审计。
合规护栏双层过滤、LangGraph 自我反思重检闭环，降低幻觉率、提升事实准确性。
医学知识图谱多跳推理突破单跳检索局限；分层长期记忆支持个性化连续咨询。
每次回答附带完整引用链路与审计日志，满足医疗场景对可解释性与合规审计的刚性需求。

evaluations: 具备大模型应用从原型到产品交付的端到端能力，重视可靠性、可解释性与可审计性。
熟悉 LangChain / LangGraph 生态与 RAG 工程化，能独立设计含合规护栏与反思闭环的复杂系统。
注重代码质量与文档沉淀，习惯将工程经验整理复用。
以产品交付标准要求产出，善于借助 AI 辅助开发工具显著提升工程效率。

projects.name: Medical Compliance RAG System
projects.stack: Python · LangChain · LangGraph · FastAPI · LangServe · Vector Database
projects.time: In Progress (Preparing to deploy to Render)
points: A Retrieval-Augmented Generation system for medical scenarios, layering multiple enhancement mechanisms on top of traditional RAG to ensure trustworthy, traceable, and auditable answers.
Dual-layer compliance guardrail filtering and LangGraph self-reflection re-check loop, reducing hallucination rates and improving factual accuracy.
Medical knowledge graph multi-hop reasoning overcoming single-hop retrieval limitations; layered long-term memory enabling personalized continuous consultations.
Every response includes a complete citation chain and audit log, meeting the rigid requirements for explainability and compliance auditing in medical scenarios.

evaluations: End-to-end capability in delivering LLM applications from prototype to production, prioritizing reliability, explainability, and auditability.
Proficient in the LangChain/LangGraph ecosystem and RAG engineering, capable of independently designing complex systems with compliance guardrails and self-reflection loops.
Emphasizes code quality and documentation, accustomed to organizing and reusing engineering experience.
Holds output to product delivery standards, skilled at leveraging AI-assisted development tools to significantly improve engineering efficiency.
